description:
Goal
Cut callable materialization, callable entries, native boundaries, identity fns, and first-class publication over to the CallableId and BoundaryId facts produced by the independent TransportPlan.

Why
Callable locality and boundary behavior are facts about a callable identity and its publication context, not shape variants and not type-recovery results. fz-hwn.20 already derives CallableId and BoundaryId facts from exact demand/escape/opaque evidence; this ticket removes consumers that still recover or select callable boundaries locally.

Required changes
Replace LocalCallableId-as-transport-authority and old callable boundary selection with TransportPlan CallableId/BoundaryId reads. Direct callable transport reads target and capture facts. First-class materialization reads the attached BoundaryId contract. Codegen/native lowering must never re-select a boundary from function plus capture types, local shape evidence, or all callable-looking producers.

Removal target
Callable boundary selection from capture types as authority, broad callable-looking type recovery, settled_callable_boundary lookup by local shape, native callable identity collection from all callable producers, callable-entry publication without first-class/opaque/escape demand, and any path that materializes a callable object without the same fact naming its BoundaryId.

Checks
Unused callable constructor publishes no entry; direct lambda call stays direct; direct callable crosses return/resume without heap closure; escaped lambda publishes exactly one BoundaryId for its demanded surface; opaque callable path has explicit BoundaryId contract; fz-hwn.13 symptom tests are either fixed here or blocked by a separate non-transport bug ticket with evidence.
title: Transport cutover: make callable materialization consume CallableId and BoundaryId facts
